values.note: $36 a night for a 30-amp site with water (82 sites, both areas), $40 for the 19 sites with 50-amp service (most pull-throughs, River area); the same on a Tuesday and a Saturday in November 2026 and June 2027 ($252 / $280 a week). The park page: 'Overnight guests pay daily ParkPass fee only once per vehicle during their stay ... Parking is not included with reservation.'

values.note: 106 electric sites (park page: '106 Tent, Trailer & RV Campsites, some seasonal'), 5 of them host sites (31, 33, 104, 106, 108), leaving 101: 87 in the River Camping Area (sites 1-89, mostly 50 ft) and 14 in the Lakeside Camping Area (sites 100-116, all 25-ft back-ins). Every public site but 52 (15 ft) takes a 23-ft rig. 19 pull-throughs. Plus 6 yurts, a pioneer campground and a paddle-in tent site.

note: GA state park on 650-acre High Falls Lake and the Towaliga River falls. Two camping areas with separate entrances: the small Lakeside Camping Area on the lake (25-ft back-ins) and the larger River Camping Area downstream along the river. Boat ramps. --Claude
